clauses: Return exactly 10 accounts; break ties in the difference by smallest account id.
Include every account whose difference ties the 10th-ranked value, so more than 10 rows may be returned.
readings: Using each order's account and that account's branch district: which accounts rank in the top 10 for how far their number of orders is above the average number of orders per account (averaged over accounts that have orders)? For each one, show the account id, the region of its branch, its order count and that difference (order count minus the average), largest difference first, unrounded. Return exactly 10 accounts; break ties in the difference by smallest account id.

Using each order's account and that account's branch district: which accounts rank in the top 10 for how far their number of orders is above the average number of orders per account (averaged over accounts that have orders)? For each one, show the account id, the region of its branch, its order count and that difference (order count minus the average), largest difference first, unrounded. Include every account whose difference ties the 10th-ranked value, so more than 10 rows may be returned.
queries:
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order" o
    GROUP BY o.account_id
)
SELECT oc.account_id,
       d.A3 AS region,
       oc.order_count,
       oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM oc) AS diff
FROM oc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
ORDER BY diff DESC, oc.account_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
WITH oc AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "order" o
    GROUP BY o.account_id
),
d AS (
    SELECT oc.account_id, di.A3 AS region, oc.cnt,
           oc.cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM oc) AS diff
    FROM oc
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, cnt AS order_count, diff AS difference
FROM d
WHERE diff >= (SELECT diff FROM d ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9)
ORDER BY diff DESC;
